rules.title: Chunk deliberately
rules.text: Chunk documents on semantic boundaries with overlap and keep source metadata with each chunk.

rules.title: Hybrid retrieval
rules.text: Combine keyword and vector search and rerank results before prompting.

rules.title: Cite sources
rules.text: Return sources with answers and say when the context does not contain the answer.

rules.title: Evaluate retrieval separately
rules.text: Measure retrieval quality separately from generation quality.

rules.title: Respect permissions
rules.text: Filter retrieval by the requesting user permissions before building the prompt.

rules.title: Reindex on change
rules.text: Reindex or invalidate embeddings when source documents change.
